content_sections.heading: IIT (BHU) Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Note: 1 seat under Junior Superintendent (26118) is reserved for a PwBD candidate. Among the five Junior Technician groups (26119–26123) combined, 1 seat is reserved for a PwBD candidate. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, or postpone/cancel the recruitment for any or all posts.

rows.no_of_posts: 21 (UR–10, OBC–5, SC–3, ST–1, EWS–2; incl. 1 PwBD)

content_sections.heading: IIT (BHU) Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Note: Pay Level equivalency for experience at other organizations (State Govt./PSU/etc.) will be examined and decided by the Competent Authority of the Institute based on nature of duties, responsibilities, and overall parity of the post.

rows.essential_qualification_experience: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline (min. 55%), with 3 years' experience at Level 5 (or equivalent) or 8 years at Level 3 or above in Central/State Govt./Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/Research Organizations; proficiency in MS Word/Excel/PowerPoint or equivalent
Bachelor's Degree in Science (Chemistry/Physics), min. 55% marks; computer proficiency required
B.E./equivalent in Mechanical/Metallurgical/Ceramic/Materials Science (min. 55%), OR 3-year Diploma in the same fields (min. 55%) with 1 year relevant experience; computer proficiency required
B.E./equivalent in Electrical/Electronics (min. 55%), OR 3-year Diploma in the same fields (min. 55%) with 1 year relevant experience; computer proficiency required
B.E./equivalent in Civil/Mining or B.Arch (min. 55%), OR 3-year Diploma in Civil/Mining (min. 55%) with 1 year relevant experience; computer proficiency required
B.E./equivalent in Computer Science/Information Technology (min. 55%), OR 3-year Diploma in the same field (min. 55%) with 1 year relevant experience; computer proficiency required
Bachelor's Degree in Library & Info. Science (55%), OR Diploma in Library & Info. Science (55%) with a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline, OR 2-year integrated M.Lib. & Info. Sc. (55%)
Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Civil/Electrical Engineering, with 5 years (degree holders) or 8 years (diploma holders) post-qualification experience at Level 6 or above
B.E./B.Tech in Civil (min. 55% or equivalent grade) with 2 years post-qualification experience, OR 3-year Diploma in Civil Engineering (55%) with 3 years post-qualification experience
Bachelor's Degree in Hindi with 3 years' translation experience (English–Hindi, technical and non-technical) in Central/State Govt./Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/Research Organizations

content_sections.heading: IIT (BHU) Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Note: Age is reckoned as on the last date of submission of the online application (24 September 2026). Reservation and age relaxation apply as per Government of India rules/norms.

content_sections.heading: IIT (BHU) Recruitment 2026 Pay Level
content_sections.text: In addition to the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, posts carry usual allowances at par with those admissible under IIT (BHU) rules for the corresponding Pay Matrix. Appointment is on regular terms with a probation period.

content_sections.heading: IIT (BHU) Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are screened based on the data submitted in the online form; more stringent criteria than the advertised minimum may be applied for shortlisting, and candidates with higher qualification/merit may be preferred. The selection process may include a Screening Test/Written Test/Presentation/Group Discussion/Personal Interview, as applicable to each post; the exact stages and schedule are not detailed in the notification and will be emailed to shortlisted candidates. Mere eligibility does not entitle a candidate to be called for the selection process. The Institute may call only the requisite number of candidates for the selection process after shortlisting on qualification, suitability, and experience. The Institute reserves the right to offer a post on contract basis instead of a regular post, depending on qualification, experience, and/or performance in the selection process. Lists of shortlisted and non-shortlisted applicants (with application numbers and reasons) will be published on the Institute website; representations on shortlisting must be submitted within 5 days of publication.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (BHU) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important: Candidates already employed in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Bodies/Educational Institutions must upload a No Objection Certificate (NOC) and Vigilance Clearance while applying online, or produce these at the time of interview. If already in service, the application must be forwarded through Proper Channel by the employer within 7 days of the last date, failing which it may not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Printout of the submitted online application form Self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents mentioned in the online application Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Experience certificate(s) in the prescribed Annexure-A format, certified by the employer/cadre-controlling authority SC/ST/OBC caste certificate in the Government of India prescribed format (OBC certificate must confirm non-creamy-layer status, not older than 6 months) NOC and Vigilance Clearance, for candidates currently in Government/Autonomous Body/Educational Institution service

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other application or selection. Posts reserved for special-ability persons (OH, VI, HH) may be filled by other special-ability categories if suitable candidates in the advertised category are unavailable. Correspondence for all recruitment stages (screening test/written test/presentation/GD/interview schedules) will be sent only via the registered email; no hard-copy letters will be sent. Furnishing false or wrong information at any stage will result in cancellation of candidature. Degree certificates must be from a recognized University/Institute. Canvassing in any manner will lead to disqualification. Any dispute related to this recruitment is subject to the jurisdiction of courts at Varanasi. The decision of the Director, IIT (BHU) is final in case of any ambiguity or dispute in the selection process.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has IIT (BHU) notified in 2026?
faq.answer: IIT (BHU) has notified 55 posts across 10 post codes in the Administrative, Technical, Library, Engineering, and Rajbhasha cadres.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT (BHU) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application on the SAMARTH portal closes on 24 September 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Do I need to send a physical copy of the application after applying online?
faq.answer: Yes, the printed application form with supporting documents must be sent by Speed Post to the Registrar, IIT (BHU), Varanasi, within 7 days of the online application closing.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Junior Technician posts at IIT (BHU)?
faq.answer: 27 years as on 24 September 2026, across all five Junior Technician groups.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for IIT (BHU) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹500 for Group B posts and ₹250 for Group C posts (other than SC/ST/PwBD/all-female candidates, who are exempted).

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written exam for IIT (BHU) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification mentions Screening Test/Written Test/Presentation/Group Discussion/Personal Interview as possible stages depending on the post; the exact process is not detailed and will be communicated to shortlisted candidates by email.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: Appointment is on regular terms with a probation period; however, the Institute reserves the right to offer some posts on a contract basis depending on qualification, experience, and selection performance.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay level for Assistant Engineer at IIT (BHU)?
faq.answer: Group B, Level 8 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
